description: Department of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources - Order made to designate the Garanduwa Lagoon in Weligama D/S Division, Matara District as a Fisheries Management Area
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made by the Minister under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, designating a specific lagoon as a Fisheries Management Area. It contains detailed legal/regulatory provisions including geographic coordinates and administrative boundaries. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements established under existing legislation.
